outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (preterm delivery, small for gestational age, neonatal intensive care unit admission)
Urgent delivery for fetal distress (operative vaginal delivery or cesarean section)
cohort: 2,326 non-anomalous singleton pregnancies undergoing Doppler assessment of CPR between 20 and 28 weeks gestation
finding: Both an abnormal second-trimester CPR and UCR are associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, but their predictive ability remains suboptimal.
